title: VIXEN Linux compiler-cache discovery misses installed ccache
body: Baseline configure at 6a116291 reports ccache/sccache not found although ccache 4.12.3 is on PATH. ProvisionCcache returns on non-Windows and the root only probes sccache. Measurement workaround: -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache. T-1584 should discover ccache on Linux and honor caller CCACHE_DIR rather than forcing a per-build directory; generic cache settings remain with queuemem.

title: Queue watchdog cancels active native builds when a measurement runner captures output
body: At base 6a116291, queued nice -n 10 python3 reports/vixcache/measure.py --name before-cold-full --cache build/before-cache -- cmake --build build/before --parallel 4 was killed with exit 75 / STALL_KILLED after 202s at native step 311/1420. The real native log kept progressing, while the queue saw only Statistics zeroed and claimed CPU/output idle. Recovery: stream Ninja progress and send periodic foreground-payload heartbeats while retaining the complete log. Consolidate descendant CPU/progress tracking so redirected native builds do not need witness-specific heartbeats. Queue log: 1790861443-build-vixcache:before-cold-full.log.

title: VIXEN reconfigure overwrites a worktree-local FetchContent cache unless its environment override is repeated
body: Queued cmake -S VIXEN -B build/before -DVIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR=$PWD/build/kernel-cache reset the existing FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR from <worktree>/.tmp/fetch to ~/.cache/vixen-fetchcontent-cache because the root uses FORCE on every configure. The command succeeded but unexpectedly populated the shared path. Recovery: repeat the same queued configure with VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=$PWD/.tmp/fetch before any build. Keep FetchContent worktree-local by default and preserve explicit cache entries; this meets vixinfra T-1461 rather than duplicating its patch.

title: Isolated VIXEN worktrees lack the required CodeGraph query index
body: codegraph explore "VIXEN CMake codegen snapshot checks compiler launcher precompiled headers" returned exit 1: no .codegraph index exists in this worktree, and the tool explicitly says not to run indexing as an agent. Recovery: inspect the measured Ninja graph, rg and source reads in this worktree. Provide a read-only common index/query route to isolated lanes so CodeGraph-first discovery works without per-lane indexing.
